tasks.title: Tabbed panel (3)
tasks.prompt:
Build a three-tab interface where each tab reveals a different panel of text. Make it work on a narrow phone screen without hiding content from assistive technology.

Return one complete, self-contained HTML document. Inline any CSS in a <style> tag. No external requests. It will be opened in a browser and checked against WCAG 2.2 AA by axe-core, and against the functional requirements above.
